svg.text: A5 – UI Approximation Design — console output capture

g.text: Enumerate |R| decode qualities x |C| cache sizes x |P| prefetch distances.
Minimise frame drops + lambda*energy subject to p95 frame time < 16 ms.
Adaptive strategy changes quality/cache/prefetch using frame time, battery and memory.
TRADE-OFF: reaches feasible smooth scrolling faster; may stop at local minimum and cannot prove global energy optimum.
